title: Transcat Reports Strong Fiscal Second Quarter 2027 Financial Results with Double-Digit Service Organic Revenue
summary: Q2’27 Service Revenue Increased 23% to $64.8 Million Q2'27 Service Gross Margin Expanded 220 Basis Points to 34% Q2’27 Distribution Revenue Grew 10% to $32.3 Million on Strong Demand for Rentals Q2'27
body_markdown:
- Q2’27 Service Revenue Increased 23% to $64.8 Million
- Q2'27 Service Gross Margin Expanded 220 Basis Points to 34%
- Q2’27 Distribution Revenue Grew 10% to $32.3 Million on Strong Demand for Rentals
- Q2'27 Total Revenue Increased 18% to $97.1 Million
- Management to Host Conference Call Today at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time
